name: floristever
description: FloristEver - jogo cozy de floricultura para web, Android e Windows.

scripts.validate: npm run build:web && npm run validate:content && node scripts/validate-build.js
scripts.test:game: node --experimental-default-type=module --test tests/content-validation.test.mjs tests/save-migrations.test.mjs tests/customer-orders.test.mjs tests/assistant-skills.test.mjs tests/theme-system.test.mjs tests/audio.test.mjs tests/shop-expansion.test.mjs tests/hud-customizer.test.mjs tests/long-term-projects.test.mjs tests/herbarium-challenge-grace.test.mjs tests/objective-care.test.mjs tests/garden-content.test.mjs tests/garden-paths.test.mjs tests/local-test-mode.test.mjs tests/main-module-syntax.test.mjs tests/player-collision.test.mjs
scripts.android:add: npm run build:web && cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run validate && cap sync android
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && cap open android
scripts.android:apk:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:apk:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
scripts.android:share:debug: npm run android:apk:debug && node scripts/package-android-share.js debug
scripts.android:share:release: npm run android:apk:release && node scripts/package-android-share.js release
